empty: No approval routes or assessments to assign here (only plant coordinators and the audit chief see them)

hintNext: Choosing a person saves it on the approval route; the launch copies them onto the assessment. They can be changed until the forms go out.
hintReadOnly: Once the forms are out, only the audit chief can reassign.

Signed steps and grey cells are not written either. Fix the Excel file and upload it again any time.
review.footNext: Cells of people not in OMS, who have left, are on leave or have an old ID are not written; another plant is only pointed out, and written; for people not enabled for CSA yet, see “What happens” above. people.title: OMS check: each ID + {{plant}}, does OMS know them?
people.note: This sheet uses {{count}} people, each checked once. CSA’s backend asks OMS; only the result is shown, no personal data.

says.other_plant: In OMS and employed, but not a {{plant}} employee (nor posted to or also covering {{plant}})
says.departed: OMS records them as having left
says.on_leave: OMS records them as on unpaid leave
says.transferred: OMS records this as an old ID from before a transfer
says.no_csa: Not enabled for CSA in OMS yet (CSA not ticked, or no active account)
says.not_listed: Not on the CSA access list yet (no CSA access request)

does.not_found: Not imported. Check the ID, or ask {{plant}}'s HR to add them in OMS
does.other_plant: Assigned. Nothing to do for cross-plant support; if it is a mistake, fix the Excel file and upload again
does.transferred: Not imported; use their new ID
does.no_csa: Assigned (only pointed out until OMS has enabled everyone). Ask the OMS administrator to tick CSA, or they cannot sign in to sign
does.no_csaRequired: Not imported. Ask the OMS administrator to tick CSA, then import again
does.not_listed: Not imported. Ask them to request CSA access; import again once a system maintainer has let them in
